name: att3-abench-fillchunk
command: for r in 1 2; do for kv in 0 1; do for f in "" "--fill-tok" "--fill-chunk 64" "--fill-chunk 256" "--fill-chunk 1024"; do tmp/att3/abench_v11 --ctx 4096 --kv $kv --phases --reps 10 --thrash 64 $f | grep phases | sed "s/^/fill[$f] /"; done; done; done
